title: Hippocampal Dynamical Regime
research_question: Do human hippocampal population dynamics favor discrete, continuous, or hybrid state-space models?
north_star: Discover a reproducible, predictive neural dynamics language.

external.role: independent convergent test conditional on anatomy/task audit

eligibility.other_mtl: entorhinal cortex, amygdala and unknown labels excluded from primary; separately labeled exploratory only
eligibility.unit_type: sorted units; SU versus MU identity unconfirmed until M1, never call all units single-neuron recordings
eligibility.session_identity: units are session-local; no persistent neuron identity assumed
eligibility.paired_alignment: verify subject/session/trial crosswalk; unpaired sessions remain explicitly unpaired and cannot enter paired iEEG analyses
eligibility.unit_qc: finite timestamps, confirmed hippocampal label, valid observation coverage; at least 20 training-window spikes; publish quality fields and SU/MU uncertainty; no heldout-rate filtering
eligibility.insufficiency: DATA_INSUFFICIENT if primary trial/unit/subject coverage fails; publish descriptive QC and stop before confirmatory model comparison

features.bin_boundary: left closed, right open; spike exactly at probe onset excluded
features.feasibility_review: training-only sparsity, coverage and convergence review before M2; retain 100 ms primary or document protocol amendment before any test access; 50/200 ms sensitivity only
features.preprocessing: fit unit selection, scaling, projections and parameters on training partition only; validation only for predefined selection; test only at frozen evaluation
features.observations: nonnegative integer spike counts and exposure; no Gaussianized counts substituted for predictive scoring
features.ieeg: separate modality and likelihood; never pool into primary spike-count endpoint

splits.algorithm: chronological whole-trial 60/20/20 per subject-session after metadata-only validity audit
splits.ordering: recorded trial number increasing; reject duplicate or missing trial identities; no shuffle
splits.purge: no windows cross trials; reset latent filter and spike history at each trial; no carryover from validation/test to train
splits.manifest_creation: M1 metadata audit, hashed and immutable before any spike-content preprocessing; no trial roster claimed at M0
splits.subject_generalization: outer leave-one-subject-out selection of shared regime/hyperparameter policy using other subjects only; test subject gets session-local emissions fitted only to its training trials under the frozen policy
splits.generalization_boundary: transfer of regime/policy with train-only target adaptation, not transfer of neuron identity or unseen-subject zero-shot count prediction
splits.external: DANDI version locked now; independent heldout trials and anatomy/task compatibility manifest frozen before external count inspection; primary policy never retuned on external data

shared.observation_link: log link with unit-specific intercept and matched exposure
shared.covariates: same causal task, timing and history covariates in all families; matched count masks
shared.training_budget: maximum 500 iterations per candidate/seed; tolerance 1e-5; report convergence and wall-clock time
shared.selection: training fits; validation-only one-standard-error selection using whole validation trials; prefer fewer free parameters, then smaller latent dimension/state count; no test selection
shared.complexity: report all fitted free parameters, state/dimension grids, same seeds and convergence rules; validation Pareto frontier and matched-complexity sensitivity; nonconverged required candidates cause gate failure, never silent family removal
shared.integration: marginal predictive count likelihood, not plug-in reconstructions or ELBO comparisons; fixed Monte Carlo budgets 64/256/1024 chosen on validation for error <=0.001 nats per unit-bin; freeze estimator and RNG seeds before test; failed accuracy gate is INCONCLUSIVE

primary_metric.name: heldout_one_step_spike_count_predictive_log_likelihood
primary_metric.formula: sum(log p(y_t | y_<t, known causal covariates, training-fitted parameters)) / observed unit-bin count
primary_metric.scoring: predict before assimilating y_t; never smooth latent state with future or current scored counts; integrate latent uncertainty; identical trial/bin/unit masks across candidates
primary_metric.aggregation: equal-weight session means within each subject, then equal-weight subject means; subject is independent unit
primary_metric.comparisons: paired subject-level model-family differences and differences vs validation-selected strongest baseline

statistics.confidence_intervals: 10000 subject bootstrap resamples, seed 20261010, paired 95% intervals; do not resample bins as independent observations
statistics.hypothesis_test: paired subject sign-flip test, exact enumeration for <=20 subjects; symmetry/exchangeability assumptions disclosed; Holm correction over three pairwise family comparisons and three family-vs-baseline tests
statistics.null_family_correction: Holm across prespecified null contrasts, separately from model-family comparisons
statistics.winner_rule: family exceeds each other family and strongest baseline by >=0.01 mean nats/unit-bin, paired CI lower bound >0 and Holm p<0.05; within-subject reproducibility and prespecified falsification gates required; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
statistics.external_rule: independent convergent result reported separately after anatomy/task audit; no direct replication across differing tasks

null_tests.control: independently permute bin positions within unit/trial, preserving trial counts/exposure; partition-local; refit full frozen pipeline
25/50/100/200 ms independent bounded jitter; reflect at trial epoch boundaries; preserve per-unit trial count; partition-local; prespecified scale curve
independent per-unit circular offsets uniform 500-2000 ms within six-second trial epoch; preserve counts and no cross-partition borrowing
combined causal trial-position/session-drift baseline plus split-local trial permutations within task/set-size strata; distinguish drift from task-aligned dynamics
random boundaries matched to number and duration distribution of training event segments; partition-local application; match evaluation masks and refit

reproducibility.within_subject: repeat chronological heldout assessment on session-local units; assess paired direction consistency across sessions and train-only split-halves; no identity correspondence across sessions
reproducibility.gate: winner must have positive differences against alternatives and strongest baseline in both chronological heldout trial halves for at least 75% of eligible subjects; report session-level direction consistency separately; test halves used only for locked assessment, never selection
reproducibility.falsification_gate: observed winner gain over strongest baseline must exceed rate-preserving, time-shift and random-segmentation null distributions under paired subject contrasts with Holm-corrected p<0.05; trial-position adjusted gain must meet primary threshold; jitter scale curve reported at all four scales without post-hoc scale selection
reproducibility.model_label_alignment: align state labels using training emissions only; permutation-invariant comparisons
reproducibility.negative_results: retain failed fits, excluded sessions, missing mappings, null outcomes and deviations
reproducibility.upstream_sorting_limitation: published units were sorted upstream at session scale; downstream train-only filtering cannot establish that upstream spike sorting was blind to heldout recordings; disclose this boundary

forbidden_claims: global P10 result rules out hippocampal discrete dynamics
metadata coverage equals eligible hippocampal coverage
different-task external convergence is direct replication
amendments: never overwrite freeze or holdout; version amendment and disclose reason before affected test access; already accessed test cannot remain a clean confirmatory holdout
